ForgeNeoBridgeSettings.description: Compatibility and additional settings. Hover over each field for help.

family.tooltip: Model family. Auto detects the connected model. The Forge compatibility path supports SD1.5, SDXL and Anima.

mode.tooltip: Txt2img creates a new image; img2img uses an input latent. The second Hires pass uses img2img.

width.tooltip: Fallback image width when no latent is connected. A connected latent supplies its own dimensions.

height.tooltip: Fallback image height when no latent is connected. A connected latent supplies its own dimensions.

batch_size.tooltip: Fallback image count when no latent is connected. A connected latent supplies its batch size.

emphasis.tooltip: Forge prompt emphasis: Original applies normalization, No norm omits it, Ignore ignores weights, and None disables emphasis parsing. Requires Forge compatibility ON.

clip_skip.tooltip: Auto uses the model default; an integer selects a CLIP layer counted from the end. Model dependent; not applied to the Forge Anima path. Retained when sampling adjustments are OFF.

comma_padding_backtrack.tooltip: Maximum token backtrack to a comma at a long-prompt chunk boundary. Zero disables it. Requires Forge compatibility ON.

rng.tooltip: Initial-noise RNG: CPU, GPU (CUDA), or NV. The same seed can produce different noise across these modes. Requires Forge compatibility ON.

ensd.tooltip: Seed delta for intermediate noise. Zero means no offset. Applied only by supported samplers with Forge compatibility and Sampling adjustments ON. The value is retained when OFF.

subseed.tooltip: Secondary seed for variations. Has no effect when variation strength is zero. Requires Forge compatibility ON.

subseed_strength.tooltip: Noise blend between the main seed and subseed: zero uses the main seed, one uses the subseed. Requires Forge compatibility ON.

seed_resize_width.tooltip: Reference width for seed resizing. Used when both reference dimensions are positive. Requires Forge compatibility ON.

seed_resize_height.tooltip: Reference height for seed resizing. Used when both reference dimensions are positive. Requires Forge compatibility ON.

eta_ancestral.tooltip: Additional-noise amount for stochastic samplers accepting Eta. Requires Sampling adjustments ON and a supporting sampler.

eta_ddim.tooltip: Preserves imported Forge DDIM Eta. It is not applied by the current Comfy DDIM path.

s_churn.tooltip: Intermediate noise churn for supporting samplers. Zero disables it. Requires Sampling adjustments ON.

s_tmin.tooltip: Minimum sigma for churn. Requires Sampling adjustments ON.

s_tmax.tooltip: Maximum sigma for churn; zero means no upper limit. Requires Sampling adjustments ON.

s_noise.tooltip: Intermediate-noise multiplier for supporting samplers. Requires Sampling adjustments ON.

sigma_min.tooltip: Minimum sigma; auto uses the model value. Requires Sampling adjustments ON and a supporting scheduler.

sigma_max.tooltip: Maximum sigma; auto uses the model value. Requires Sampling adjustments ON and a supporting scheduler.

rho.tooltip: Curve parameter for Karras and other supporting schedulers. Auto uses the default. Requires Sampling adjustments ON.

beta_alpha.tooltip: Alpha shape parameter of the Beta schedule. Requires Sampling adjustments ON.

beta_beta.tooltip: Beta shape parameter of the Beta schedule. Requires Sampling adjustments ON.

discard_penultimate.tooltip: Remove the penultimate sigma. Some samplers also require this independently. This override requires Sampling adjustments ON.

sgm_noise_multiplier.tooltip: Use the SGM initial-noise multiplier for txt2img. Not applied to Anima. Requires Sampling adjustments ON.

shift.tooltip: Noise-timestep shift for Anima. Auto retains the imported setting. Requires Sampling adjustments ON; not applied to other families.

skip_early_cfg.tooltip: Fraction of early denoising calls that skip CFG. Zero disables it. Requires Sampling adjustments ON.

ngms.tooltip: Sigma threshold below which negative conditioning may be skipped. Zero disables it. Requires Sampling adjustments ON.

ngms_all_steps.tooltip: Evaluate NGMS on every denoiser call instead of alternating calls. Requires Sampling adjustments ON.

img2img_step_mode.tooltip: Forge_scaled shortens the run according to denoise; exact_steps executes the requested count. With adjustments OFF, core ComfyUI step calculation is used.

img2img_extra_noise.tooltip: Additional starting noise for img2img. Zero disables it. Requires Sampling adjustments ON.

original_width.tooltip: SDXL original-width conditioning. Zero uses the current latent width. Requires Forge compatibility ON.

original_height.tooltip: SDXL original-height conditioning. Zero uses the current latent height. Requires Forge compatibility ON.

target_width.tooltip: SDXL target-width conditioning. Zero uses the current latent width. Does not resize the image. Requires Forge compatibility ON.

target_height.tooltip: SDXL target-height conditioning. Zero uses the current latent height. Does not resize the image. Requires Forge compatibility ON.

crop_x.tooltip: Horizontal crop conditioning for SDXL. Does not crop the actual image. Requires Forge compatibility ON.

crop_y.tooltip: Vertical crop conditioning for SDXL. Does not crop the actual image. Requires Forge compatibility ON.

zero_empty_negative.tooltip: Zero empty SDXL negative conditioning. Requires Forge compatibility ON.

source_json.tooltip: Imported source settings for inspection. Normally no editing is needed. Generation uses the current node values.

forge_compatibility.tooltip: ON uses Forge text processing and initial noise; the next switch controls sampling adjustments. OFF uses core ComfyUI text encoding and KSampler. Bridge must remain installed in both modes.

sampling_adjustments.tooltip: Default ON. With Forge compatibility ON, OFF uses ComfyUI samplers and schedules; ON applies Forge sampling adjustments. Neither identical nor visually similar images are guaranteed. Older workflows load with this ON to preserve their behavior.

ForgeNeoBridgeKSampler.description: Generate using current node values. Settings controls Forge compatibility and sampling adjustments.

model.tooltip: Connect the generation model from a loader or LoRA node.

positive.tooltip: Connect positive input from Bridge Text Encode.

negative.tooltip: Connect negative input from Bridge Text Encode.

settings.tooltip: Connect Bridge Settings to choose compatibility processing and additional options.

seed.tooltip: Random seed. Edit with arrows or numeric entry. Choose how it changes between runs using control after generate.

steps.tooltip: Sampling step count. Executed img2img steps also depend on denoise and the adjustment setting.

cfg.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance strength. Higher values do not always give better results.

sampler_name.tooltip: Method used at each sampling step. The same name may differ between Forge and ComfyUI; Sampling adjustments selects the execution path.

scheduler.tooltip: Noise schedule. With adjustments OFF, Automatic and Uniform use Comfy Normal, and DDIM uses ddim_uniform. Forge-only schedules require adjustments ON.

denoise.tooltip: How strongly to change the input latent. One is full denoising; zero leaves it unchanged with adjustments OFF. Forge step counts also depend on the step mode.

input_latent.tooltip: Connect latent data from Empty Latent Image or VAE Encode. This input supplies dimensions and batch size.

0.tooltip: Generated or prepared latent for VAE Decode and other latent nodes.

ForgeNeoBridgeScheduler.description: Build core ComfyUI sigmas with penultimate-sigma removal. This dedicated node is independent of the Settings switches.

model.tooltip: Connect the generation model from a loader or LoRA node.

steps.tooltip: Requested number of sampling intervals, after removing the penultimate sigma.

denoise.tooltip: Fraction of the full noise schedule to use. Zero returns an empty sigma sequence.

0.tooltip: Sequence of noise levels used for sampling.
